column1: # Context used below: D_8008BE52 is the battle state (bit 1 in battle, 2 enemy side's turn, 0x100 boss battle: func_8001F164 sets 0x305 when a DAE0 boss starts the fight); D_8008BE58 indexes the turn order D_8007C050; func_8001FC14 (1FA00) ends the current turn (toggles bit 2, advances D_8008BE58 to the next enemy with HP).

column3: zeroes the enemy count, marks all 6 D_8007B908 slots free (unk50 = -1) and, if the area flag D_800842E8 & 1 (the same flag that gates random encounters in 1FA00) is set, loads the area's enemy set; called from the area-load sequence in 1870
calls the state handler D_8004DD20[e->type] for every occupied slot, then the boss attack script when D_8008BE52 & 0x100; called each frame from 1870 while a battle runs

for every occupied slot draws the animated model (func_80020428/func_8002099C) and the ground shadow (func_800131F0) and collects the object into D_8007C030 (the list func_8000C05C collides against); called from the 1870 draw sequence
picks D_800561A0[area->unk12], sets the anim table D_8007C048 from it and DMAs its ROM range (func_80028120) to D_8020E6F0

for every occupied slot clears its HUD status indicators (Hud_ClearActorStatusIndicators) and frees it (unk50 = -1), then zeroes the count; called by Battle_UpdateTurnTransition (1FA00) when a battle ends

fills a slot from enemy def idx of the loaded set (HP/MP unkA/unkC from def->unk6, scale, stats, state 0) and places it on the ground at (x, z) with angle via func_800107F0; called per enemy by 1FA00's encounter setup func_8001FF10
bubble-sorts the slot indices into D_8007C050 by def->unkC, highest first; 1FA00 compares the player's stats +0xC against D_8007C050[0]'s def->unkC to decide which side moves first
sets flags bit 1 on the enemy D_8007C050[D_8008BE58]; called by 1FA00 when a turn starts on the enemy side (D_8008BE52 & 2); Enemy_StateIdle reacts to that bit

state 0 (D_8004DD20[0]): applies the anim step; when its turn bit is set it ends the turn at once if status unk98 & 8, else picks an attack (Enemy_ChooseAttack) and starts it or switches to state 1 (approach) with a move counter

state 1: turns toward the player (Enemy_TurnToward) and moves (range-limited, Enemy_Move clamp=1); each step checks the chosen attack's range and starts it, or on running out of steps/range attacks or goes back to idle and ends the turn

state 2 (set by Enemy_TakeDamage): plays out the hit anim; at the end, if HP unkA is 0 it plays the death effects, frees the slot, decrements the count and adds def->unk10/unk14 to the battle rewards D_8007A9B4/B8 (3F50 adds them to the player's stats), else back to state 0
state 3 (D_8004DD20[3]): turns toward the player and applies the anim step until the timer runs out, then state 0 and ends the turn (func_8001FC14); no setter of state 3 found in the C yet

state 4 (Enemy_StartAttack with attack id bit 0x8000 clear): in the active phase, once within the attack's range unk14 of the player, rolls the hit (Enemy_RollHitOnPlayer) and damages the player (Player_TakeDamage) with a hit spark, or on a miss calls Player_StartDodge; then the recovery anim
state 5 (attack id bit 0x8000 set): after the wind-up timer casts spell (id & ~0x8000) with func_800169B8 (the magic module's cast entry), then waits out the anim and returns to state 0

sorts the def's attack list (unk30, unk2C entries) by range unk10, picks the first whose range covers the player's distance (random between two near the edge, flags 0x10 if it must approach first), random pick if def->unk24 & 4; stores it in e->unk1C

sets state 5 for a spell attack (id & 0x8000, refused if status unk98 & 0x40) or 4 otherwise, faces the player, starts the attack anim, points the battle camera at it (func_80015F44) and in a boss battle starts the attack script
turns obj->angle 5% of the wrapped angle difference toward the point (x, z) per call

adds knockback velocity (decays 0.9), with clamp keeps the enemy within its move radius around D_8008BE64/68 (flags 2 when hit), keeps it inside the battle circle D_8008BE5C/60/6C, resolves collisions, moves and snaps to the ground (func_800107F0)
samples the current anim's root motion (func_80020214) and rotates (-unk44, unk4C) by the enemy's angle into out; every state passes the result to Enemy_Move as the step
pushes the proposed step out of the first overlapping circle: the player, the other drawn enemies (D_8007C030), then the map obstacle list D_8007C2A8 (kind 0x10 map objects, E2A0)
returns rand(100) < 100*a/(a + (b+7)/8) with a = the enemy's stat unk86 and b = the player's (D_8007AA88); used by the melee state and by 17360 when a spell's target is the player
attack stat unk11C * unk122 / 16; 1 in 32 critical (x1.5, a 4-frame screen flash Fade_Start(4, 0, D_8004F760), flags 0x20 so the hit uses 0xC004); halved under status unk98 & 1

damages enemy slot idx: element table D_8004DD38 halves or adds 25%, physical hits from behind (> 135 deg) x1.5, scaled by attacker unk84 vs defence unk120, random bonus, subtracts HP, damage popup (func_8001AE24), enters state 2; returns the damage; called by the player (3F50) and spells (17360)
Hud_ShowActorPopup (popup 0x2D) on the actor passed in a0 (the C prototype is void; callers pass the target) and sound 0x17; called by 3F50 and 17360 when an attack on an enemy misses
returns the index 0..5 of obj in D_8007B908 (6 if not found); 17360 uses it to turn a target object into a slot for Enemy_TakeDamage
spawns the visual effect described by D_80056718 at the enemy (Magic_CreateVisualEffect) and a burst emitter sized to it (Effect_StartBurstEmitter); only caller Enemy_StateHurt when HP reaches 0
D_8007C064 = NULL (no attack script running); called by 1FA00 when a boss battle starts
sets up the attack script: frame counter 0, script D_800566C8[id], attacker, object of slot 0; called by Enemy_StartAttack only in a boss battle

steps the attack script: when the frame counter passes an entry's time it either sets the attacker's push velocity (flag 8) or spawns an effect at an offset from the attacker or the player (func_80019820), shakes the camera on flag 4 (func_80015D78), stops on flag 1
D_8007C13C[0] = 0, the 8 bits Boss_IsDefeated/Boss_SetDefeated use; called at the top of the 1870 game loop

finds the D_803AB3D0 entry for the current map/sub-area (D_800842BC/C0); if that boss is not defeated, DMAs its model to D_802A7BC0, inits its record (Boss_Spawn) and sets D_8007C140 = boss + 1; called in the 1870 area-load sequence after Enemy_InitForArea
if a boss is present (D_8007C140) draws its animated model and shadow, same calls as Enemy_DrawAll; called from the 1870 draw sequence
returns D_8007C140 if the player is within the boss's trigger radius D_803AB48C[n], else 0; 3F50 then calls Boss_BeginEncounter

inits an enemy record from boss def D_803AB820[i] (same fields as Enemy_Spawn) grounded at (x, z), angle arg3; boss 7 sinks 30 units with flags 4; called by Boss_LoadForArea and by 1FA00 into slot 0 when the boss battle starts
returns bit i of D_8007C13C (mask table D_8004F770); 9D50 NPCs pick their message by it
sets bit i of D_8007C13C; called by 1FA00 when a boss battle is won

copies boss i's name (0x20) and message (0x4B0) into the text buffers D_8007B8E0/D_8007B430 (as Cutscene_CopyMessageBuffers does) and aims the camera at a copy of the boss object (Camera_SetTargetView); 3F50 calls it when Boss_CheckPlayerNear fires, then opens the text window (D_8004DCA0 |= 2)

called by Battle_UpdateTurnTransition (1FA00) after Boss_SetDefeated: bosses 0..6 raise max HP (stats +6) and max MP (+0xA) by D_8004DD50/D_8004DD60[i], cap 500, and refill both; boss 7 instead loads its message, opens the text window and starts the area exit with D_8007A172 = 4 (the ending cutscenes); renamed from GiveDefeatReward, which did not cover boss 7
